description: Rothco's Tacticanvas Go Pack merges the tactical elements of our popular Medium Transport Packs with the classic appeal of heavyweight canvas material. Crafted from durable canvas with strong polyester straps, this versatile pack is built to endure rugged use while maintaining a timeless look. The pack features 1 large main compartment with an interior mesh pocket, providing ample storage for all your essentials. Additionally, the 25L backpack includes 5 zippered storage compartments to keep your items organized and easily accessible. For added comfort, the tactical pack has padded adjustable shoulder straps and a padded back with breathable mesh backing. The top carry handle offers an alternative carrying option, while the Y-shaped adjustable quick-release cinch straps and side cinch straps ensure your gear stays secure. Our Tacticanvas Go Pack has a 25 liter capacity and measures 17 inch x 10 inch x 9 inch, perfect for everyday carry and outdoor adventures. Made from Rothco’s durable heavyweight canvas fabric, this superior material is naturally water-resistant, rugged, and is built for the long haul. No one comes close to Rothco’s collection of ultra-premium canvas bags and packs.
